issues.description: Duplicate db.sh entries: one in TEMPLATE patch, one as new symlink in the recipe
issues.detail: The diff modifies egs2/TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh to add TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads, but also creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a new file (symlink) to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. That's the expected layout, but the diff shows db.sh added twice in tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/ — verify only the symlink exists and there isn't a stray real file shadowing it.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh continues execution when unzip is missing
issues.detail: Lines 9-11 print a warning when unzip is not installed but do not exit. With set -euo pipefail, later unzip invocations will fail with command-not-found, but the script proceeds past the check. Should be `echo ... >&2; exit 1` to fail fast with a clear message.

issues.description: Argument-count check prints usage but does not exit
issues.detail: In download_and_untar.sh lines 13-21, when $# is out of range the script prints usage but falls through to `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)`, which will fail or behave unpredictably with zero args. Add `exit 1` after the usage heredoc.

issues.description: data.sh sources download_and_untar.sh instead of executing it
issues.detail: Line 35 uses `. ./local/download_and_untar.sh ...` which sources the script into the current shell. download_and_untar.sh sets `set -euo pipefail` and uses `exit`, which will terminate data.sh on any failure path (including the missing-zip warning branches that fall through). Invoke it as `./local/download_and_untar.sh` (executable) instead. Also note download_and_untar.sh is not chmod +x in the diff (mode 100644).

issues.description: Aggressive sed substitutions may corrupt Chinese transcripts
issues.detail: data.sh lines 49-51 strip `#`, `=`, and various CJK punctuation globally from the transcripts. Stripping `=` and `#` from arbitrary lecture transcripts is risky if those characters occur inside content (math notation in math lectures especially). Document why these are safe to remove or restrict the substitution to known-bad fields.

issues.description: README config path link is broken
issues.detail: README.md line 16 links to `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` but the actual file is at `./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (no `train/` subdir). Fix the path so the link resolves.

review.summary: New ESPnet recipe for the TAL Mandarin teaching ASR dataset. Bulk of the diff is boilerplate symlinks and standard configs; the recipe-specific logic lives in local/data.sh and local/download_and_untar.sh. Several control-flow issues in download_and_untar.sh (missing exits on warning paths) and a sourced-vs-executed call in data.sh can mask errors or terminate the parent shell. Transcript cleanup uses aggressive global seds that may need justification for math content. README has a stale config path. No correctness issues in the YAML configs themselves.
